constraints: CHECK (photo_path IS NULL OR photo_path = (((author_id::text || '/'::text) || id::text) || '.jpg'::text))
FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES staygrubby.accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (post_description IS NULL OR length(post_description) <= 2000 AND regexp_replace(post_description, '[
	]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text)

CHECK (rank_at_sharing IS NULL AND ranked_count_at_sharing IS NULL OR rank_at_sharing IS NOT NULL AND ranked_count_at_sharing IS NOT NULL AND score_text IS NOT NULL AND rank_at_sharing >= 1 AND rank_at_sharing <= ranked_count_at_sharing)
